name: Switchyard by soum91
subtitle: Your OpenWrt ASUS and TP-Link in one app
description: Runs the OpenWrt ASUS router and the TP-Link Archer from one place: live speed, devices (kick and block), ad blocking and your own blocked sites, the WARP tunnel, Wi-Fi and guest network, light schedule, drop log, diagnostics and reboot.
